scope_note: Reconciles the project's dependency + license facts as OBSERVABLE in the repository WITHOUT downloading anything or copying secrets. Covers five ecosystems (Cargo, npm, Python, models, non-code assets) plus the PROJECT license reconciliation (root LICENSE vs Cargo metadata vs README/docs). Records every license conflict, every missing lock/checksum, every reachability owner, every Unknown, and a target F1/F5 disposition per item. This EXTENDS the 0.3.5 model-license-inventory.json, which pinned the embedding-model facts and explicitly DEFERRED this broader reconciliation here (see model-license-inventory.json `deferred_to_0_3_6`).

method: Static inventory of committed manifests and lockfiles plus on-disk artifact listing, no network. Read: root Cargo.toml (workspace) + all 8 member-crate Cargo.toml; Cargo.lock (resolved closure); vendor/piper-rs/Cargo.toml (patched path crate); ui/package.json + ui/package-lock.json; all sidecar requirements.txt (kria-tts/kria-vision/kria-stt) + kria-modules/pyproject.toml; openclaw-substrate/package.json + ancillary package.json manifests; root LICENSE and README license section; design.md §1 + requirements MGR-047; .gitignore (to determine committed vs local-only artifacts); `models/` tree listing + on-disk LICENSE/metadata files. Each fact is Known (with an in-repo evidence locator) or Unknown. NO license is inferred from a package name, upstream reputation, or code comment.
invariants_applied: No license is inferred from package name, upstream reputation, or repository comment. A license is Known ONLY with an in-repo license field/file/metadata; otherwise Unknown.
Do NOT download anything. Model/asset artifacts absent from the repo cannot have their bytes hashed in F0; their checksums are Unknown/missing.
Dormant code/comments/tests are not capability proof.
Secrets are never copied into reports (.env family read-avoided).
MGR-047.11: every shipped model/runtime/asset/font/icon/crate/package MUST have an exact lock/checksum AND a reviewed FOSS license disposition — every gap is recorded as a release blocker.
MGR-047.1: exact locks/checksums must be COMMITTED (a lockfile that is git-ignored or absent does not satisfy the gate).
